issue.title: rust-lsp-install copies sase-xprompt-lsp from the checkout-local target dir and exits 0 after cp/chmod/mv fail
issue.description: just install reports a successful sase-xprompt-lsp install while actually copying nothing, because rust-lsp-install hard-codes the checkout-local cargo target directory and its single-line install step never propagates a copy failure. Found twice while landing epic sase-um (phase notes sase-um.3 and sase-um.4).

task_type_fields.impact:
Every agent whose host sets a cargo `target-dir` (this one does, globally) silently
keeps a stale `sase-xprompt-lsp` in its workspace venv while `just install` reports
success. Nothing downstream can notice: the recipe's exit code is 0, so `just install`
is green and no gate re-checks the installed binary's version. Agents then debug
xprompt LSP behavior against a binary that does not match the tree they are editing.
task_type_fields.repro:
`just install` runs `rust-lsp-install` (Justfile:998). Its build step is

    cd "{{ sase_core_dir }}" && cargo build --release -p sase_xprompt_lsp

and its install step (Justfile:1015-1022) then copies from a hard-coded path:

    dest="{{ VENV }}/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp"; \
    src="{{ sase_core_dir }}/target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp"; \
    tmp="$dest.tmp.$$"; \
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; \
    cp "$src" "$tmp"; \
    chmod +x "$tmp"; \
    mv -f "$tmp" "$dest"; \
    printf "[rust-lsp-install] installed %s\n" "$dest"

Two independent defects compound:

1. `src` assumes cargo wrote to the checkout-local `target/`. This host's
   `~/.cargo/config.toml` sets `target-dir = "/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target"`, so the
   binary is actually at `/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target/release/sase-xprompt-lsp` and the
   `cp` reads a path that does not exist. `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, a workspace
   `.cargo/config.toml`, and `build.target-dir` are all equally unhandled.

2. The whole install step is one `@`-prefixed, `;`-separated shell line with no
   `set -e`. A failing `cp` therefore does not stop `chmod` or `mv`, and the recipe's
   exit status is `printf`'s, which is 0. So the recipe prints cp/chmod/mv errors,
   prints `[rust-lsp-install] installed ...`, and exits 0.

REPRODUCE:

    grep -n 'target-dir' ~/.cargo/config.toml     # target-dir = /mnt/poseidon/cargo-target
    just install                                   # prints cp/chmod/mv errors, exits 0
    .venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp --version           # stale version, not the one just built

Observed twice while landing epic sase-um: phase sase-um.4 recorded `just install`
building `sase-xprompt-lsp` under `/mnt/poseidon/cargo-target/release`, trying to copy
from the checkout-local target, printing cp/chmod/mv failures, and still exiting 0.
Phase sase-um.3 independently recorded the same shape with a concrete version skew:
`.venv/bin/sase-xprompt-lsp --version` reported 0.32.6 after `sase_core_rs` 0.32.8 had
been built in the same `just install`.
